title: Innovative Solutions for HDB Flats to Ensure Direct Lift Access to Every Floor Despite Flat Design
what_it_is: Innovative Solutions for HDB Flats to Ensure Direct Lift Access to Every Floor Despite Flat Design

sections.label: Lift Upgrading Programme and Lift access Housing Grant
sections.summary: About 270 HDB blocks received bubble or machine room-less lifts under LUP, with some blocks exceeding the cost cap, while residents in remaining blocks without direct lift access may get the Lift access Housing Grant.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Under the Lift Upgrading Programme, or LUP, about 270 HDB blocks were provided with bubble lifts or machine room-less lifts.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: For some blocks, HDB exercised some flexibility and went beyond the LUP cost cap, so that all the residents in these blocks would be able to have direct lift access.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: This notwithstanding, providing lifts for some of the remaining 150 blocks without full direct lift access today will be very costly – in some cases, more than $200,000 per household, enough to buy another HDB flat.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: In the meantime, residents living in these blocks who are in urgent need of direct lift access due to medical conditions or mobility reasons, are eligible for the Lift access Housing Grant (LHG) of up to $30,000 when they buy another flat with direct lift access.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: As with all flat owners, when they take possession of another flat, they are given a grace period of six months to dispose of their existing flat.

sections.label: Segmented blocks in Keat Hong ward
sections.summary: Of the 150 segmented blocks in Singapore, 30 blocks are within the Keat Hong ward of Chua Chu Kang GRC.

sentences.speaker: Mr Zhulkarnain Abdul Rahim (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Out of the 150 blocks in the whole of Singapore that are segmented, 20% of those, or 30 blocks, are within the Keat Hong ward of the Chua Chu Kang GRC in my constituency.

sections.label: LUP benefiting units and polls
sections.summary: LUP has counted only units without direct lift access as benefiting units, with costs shared and polls conducted among these units, which the speaker views as a cleaner approach.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: If we look at how we have been doing LUP, we have always only considered the units that do not have direct lift access as the benefiting units of the LUP, since the cost of the LUP has always been shared amongst these units only.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: LUP polls have also always been conducted only among these benefiting units.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The current method of counting only the units without direct lift access as benefiting units may thus be, in our view, a cleaner approach.
